_baseline: 50-user 60s smoke run — 2026-05-08, 800-table dataset, MacBook dev hardware
_note: 50-user smoke test must not exceed these values. Numbers reflect the post-audit code (search_all_metadata with LEFT JOINs to data_quality_cache + business_name_overrides) and are intentionally generous (~25% headroom over observed p99) so the smoke test fails on real regressions, not noise.
_history: Initial 300-user baseline captured 2026-04-29 became too tight after the search-query joins were added. Re-baselined 2026-05-08 from the dev-laptop smoke run; production-grade hardware should hit lower numbers. Re-tighten when running on prod-equivalent infra.
_failure_note: 1% tolerance covers transient auth-session setup failures in dev environments

duckdb_search.description: Broad and narrow search queries (UNION across tables + columns + LEFT JOINs to data_quality_cache + business_name_overrides)

duckdb_simple.description: Single-table queries: columns fetch, permissions, export CSV

duckdb_related.description: Related-tables UNION JOIN — the most expensive query path
